en-US.description: Easily connect Microsoft Excel to over 105 data sources for real-time data download and/or upload using easy Excel formulas, fast table downloads and feature-rich risk models.
en-US.longDescription: Various data sources are available as cloud and database data for real-time access within Microsoft Excel using Invantive Control for Excel. The pre-defined Excel formulas varies per data source from generic Excel formulas for data exchange and securing the data, to hundreds of Microsoft Excel formulas matching the business-logic of a cloud software solution. Custom Excel formulas for data exchange can easily be added using Visual Basic for Applications. Just log on to refresh data from Excel formulas in real-time. Multiple different data sources can jointly be accessed in real-time. Both database data as well as cloud data and file data can be used as source for any data source. Scalability from small to large enterprises is provided through the solid foundation on Invantive UniversalSQL, including the availability of many complex data filters, and advanced models in the model repository integrated into each Microsoft Excel workbook.
en-US.name: Invantive Control for Excel

zh-CN.description: 轻松将 Microsoft Excel 连接至 105+ 种数据源，实现实时数据下载/上传：通过简易 Excel 公式、快速表格下载及功能丰富的风险模型。
zh-CN.longDescription: 多种数据源可作为云端及数据库数据，通过 Invantive Control for Excel 在 Microsoft Excel 中实现实时访问。预定义的 Excel 公式因数据源而异，涵盖从通用数据交换与数据安全的基础公式，到匹配云端软件业务逻辑的数百个专业 Excel 函数。用户可通过 Visual Basic for Applications 轻松添加自定义数据交换公式。只需登录即可实时刷新 Excel 公式数据，并支持同时访问多个异构数据源——无论是数据库、云端数据还是文件数据均可作为数据源使用。基于 Invantive UniversalSQL 的坚实架构，系统提供从小型企业到大型企业的弹性扩展能力，包括丰富的复杂数据筛选器支持，以及集成在每个 Excel 工作簿模型库中的高级数据模型。
